DeterminationBasis: The current T02 tests establish identity continuity, changed-object distinguishability, canonicalisation completeness, temporal object context and hash-algorithm declaration, but none directly establishes that every versioned object explicitly identifies its version.

Canonicalisation completeness and hash-algorithm declaration do not directly test whether an object's own final digest is excluded from the bytes over which that digest is calculated, nor whether any alternative construction is demonstrably non-circular.
